items.raw_excerpt: A meteorologist says severe gusts hit 168 km/h on Sunday morning at Wellington's Mt Kaukau, but as the wind coming from the Tasman Sea eases, the country is being treated to unusually warm weather during winter.

items.summary_en: A large march took place on Saturday in central Santiago, Chile. Many groups walked along the Alameda to defend nature and protect animals. They asked leaders to act fast against climate change.
